annotations.title: Claim a draft into your account

description: Moves an anonymous draft onto the account of the signed-in user after they have authorized. Call this only once the user has said they want to keep the site - never before, and never as a precondition for building.

draft_token.description: The draft token to claim. Falls back to the x-pagetool-draft-token header when omitted.
